applicant. 
 Mr. Amit Kapri, Brief Holder for the State of 
Uttarakhand.

appellant / applicant, we have not been able to take a 
prima facie view that judgment under Appeal is 
interferable and, at the same time, appellant / applicant 
has effectively kept himself concealed from this Court 
without furnishing any particulars of him in the 
Application. 
 The Bail Application is rejected. 
 
 
 
(Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) (Barin Ghosh, C.J.)
